identification: Mixed box of small used collectables. Only item with a clear local comp is the Royal Agricultural Society of Victoria enamel badge (round, crowned, blue and white enamel, monogram centre). Two marbled celluloid lever-filler fountain pens (makers unread, nibs unseen, gold or steel unknown), dip pen, engine-turned compact, Boot Scootin belt buckle, Bonanza pin badge, brass slipper ashtray, keys, advertising penknife letter opener, razor, shakers.

chrome_hint: eBay AU sold (and Terapeak): 'celluloid marbled lever filler fountain pen' ; 'vintage fountain pen black gold marble lever filler'; 'Royal Agricultural Society of Victoria enamel badge'; 'Boot Scootin belt buckle'. Also check Noble Numismatics archive for RAS Victoria badge. Identify pen makers first (Conway Stewart, Mentmore, Wyvern, Platignum, Croxley) as 14ct nibs or named makers change value.
viewing_check: Open both fountain pens: read barrel imprint (maker, model), nib marking (14ct or 18ct gold vs steel), check for cracks, shrinkage or lever filler working. Check back of RAS badge for maker mark (Stokes, Luke, Orbuck) and gilt/silver. Check whether the compact is silver or hallmarked.
